statement: The full local centralizer of the actual generated action is a free proper Lie group and preserves every global quotient partition. Its dimension-two orbits enlarge the closed exponential contraction region. Finitely many remaining operator-orbit representatives with compact quotients by their full local centralizers admit a compatible contraction across all accumulations of their operator translates, relative to that enlarged region, with joint inverse continuity.
depends_on: C30 full transitive-action centralizer; C32-C33 intrinsic contractions and surface Lie property; C36-C37 two-dimensional exponential source and uniform bound; C42 evaluation homeomorphism; C43-C50 quotient-coordinate contractions and uniform limit proof; C52 hybrid prescription; C53 global quotient maps and exact transports

depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The local centralizer is specified with its compact-open topology and no unproved global extension map is used.
notes: The inclusion of the old proper operator closure Q_O into the full local centralizer is explicit. Every local centralizer element commutes with L restricted to O by global approximation of L. Therefore each h_n q_n is itself a continuous L-equivariant map into the plane, and the C42 evaluation homeomorphism gives its compact-open quotient limit directly. The exact formula Phi_z q=Phi_(a_q z) proves preservation of all global quotient partitions. The intrinsic constructions consequently commute with the full local centralizer. Compact fundamental sets, the small L-translation y to y_n, exact quotient equations, and diagonal approximation give closure and inverse continuity. The claimed scope retains finitely many H-representatives, compact full-local-centralizer quotients, and the unresolved exterior nonopen extension.
